progression.narrative: The performance opens on D3 and dwells most on C in Reng-e Shahrashub. The line peaks at Dk5 (549.7 Hz) at 1:01.5. It closes on Ak3, not the tonic (G4 → F4 → E4 → Ak3 → C4 → Ak3).
